params.q: What is the normal blood sugar level 2 hours after a meal in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the normal blood sugar level 2 hours after a meal in India?

response.markdown:
The normal blood sugar level **2 hours after a meal** (postprandial) for a healthy, non-diabetic adult is **below 140 mg/dL (7.8 mmol/L)**. [0] [1] [2] [3] [4]

| Category | 2-Hour Post-Meal (mg/dL) | 2-Hour Post-Meal (mmol/L) |
|---|---|---|
| **Normal** | < 140 | < 7.8 |
| **Prediabetes** | 140 – 199 | 7.8 – 11.0 |
| **Diabetes** | ≥ 200 | ≥ 11.1 |

For people already diagnosed with diabetes, the target is typically **below 180 mg/dL (10 mmol/L)** two hours after eating. [2] [0]

0. [Blood Sugar After Meal: What’s Normal & When It’s Dangerous](https://clearmedi.in/blog/blood-sugar-after-meal-what-s-normal-when-it-s-dangerous)
